propositions: On fresh upgrade (store file absent), all managed refs with bound targets must be backfilled as confirmed records with source=backfill and direction=backfill
Backfill must not run on an existing but empty store file; it runs only when the file was absent at load

The evidence step must use a single store instance opened once, with backfill executed before snapshot confirmation on that same instance, preventing lost updates and ensuring same-pass provenance upgrades
Backfill must not downgrade existing provenance: it skips any key already carrying a push or snapshot record, while later snapshot confirmation may overwrite backfilled entries
Backfilled records are treated as confirmed by is_confirmed(), and backfill runs are one-shot: subsequent passes add zero records once the file exists
